entities.name: Extended EPS QoS
entities.description: Information element used to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the UE when values exceed the maximum specified in the EPS quality of service information element.

entities.name: EPS quality of service information element
entities.description: Standard EPS QoS information element defined in clause 9.9.4.3 that specifies maximum bit rate values.

entities.name: Extended QoS transmission condition
entities.description: Condition where network wishes to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values and at least one value exceeds the maximum specified in the EPS QoS IE.

relations.description: Extended EPS QoS IE is included in messages only when the extended QoS transmission condition is met.
The condition references the maximum value specified in the EPS QoS information element as a threshold comparison.
